ModMetaData.name: ManyWaters
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Generic water-effects engine (engine promoted from RUT RiverSteam per R10: ManyWaters gathers all water effects/types — steaming, boiling, etc. — as they land). Currently ships the animated river-steam ambience: periodic "Steam" FleckDef puffs off river cells, reusing vanilla's own TerrainDef.IsRiver test — a pure ambience feature, no gameplay effect. NOTE: MapComponent_RiverSteam still gates on the literal biome defName `ZBiome_Grasslands` (the Pyrelands) inherited untouched from RiverSteam's Source/ — generalizing that gate is future work, not done by this promotion. Campaign-specific wiring lives in RimUtinni: UtinniPatches.
